overall_comment: A 51-year-old male with a right frontal lobe tumor. Imaging features are most consistent with a high-grade glioma. The presence of extensive necrosis and satellite lesions strongly supports a diagnosis of Glioblastoma, IDH-wildtype, CNS WHO grade 4. While the tumor has a large non-enhancing component and involves the insula, features more typical of IDH-mutant astrocytoma, the aggressive markers of necrosis and satellites are considered more definitive for molecular subtyping and grading.
